orbit join: verified orbit for linux/amd64 (sha256 24a377d362083c6616f94f693392277826f71c998c1984177fa99dc022315b66)
orbit join: responder app1; UE pools 10.250.0.0/16 via 198.51.100.1, N6 198.51.100.0/24
orbit join: N6 IP 198.51.100.20 on ens5 (from the route to the UPF's N6 address 198.51.100.1; override with --n6-ip)
orbit join: control bind 192.0.2.20:9551 on ens4 (from the route to the server at 192.0.2.10; override with --bind)

Plan:
  1. install the verified orbit as /usr/local/lib/orbit/orbit (sha256 24a377d362083c6616f94f693392277826f71c998c1984177fa99dc022315b66)
  2. route UE pool 10.250.0.0/16 back through the UPF
       ip -4 route replace 10.250.0.0/16 via 198.51.100.1 dev ens5
  3. firewall: iptables chain ORBIT-JOIN with the control and data rules
       iptables -N ORBIT-JOIN
       iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 192.0.2.10/32 -i ens4 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 9551 -j ACCEPT
       iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 10.250.0.0/16 -i ens5 -p udp -m udp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT
       iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 10.250.0.0/16 -i ens5 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT
       iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 198.51.100.0/24 -i ens5 -p udp -m udp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT
       iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 198.51.100.0/24 -i ens5 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT
       (data ports 32768-60999: this host's ephemeral range (net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range), since the responder's receivers bind ephemeral ports)
  4. firewall: iptables INPUT jumps to ORBIT-JOIN first
       iptables -I INPUT 1 -m comment --comment orbit-join -j ORBIT-JOIN
  5. create the system user orbit, which the responder runs as
       useradd --system --user-group --no-create-home --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin orbit
  6. install /usr/local/lib/orbit/join-net.sh (run as root before the responder starts):
       | #!/bin/sh
       | # orbit join: re-applies the N6 route and firewall rules for orbit-responder.service.
       | set -eu
       | PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
       | ip -4 route replace 10.250.0.0/16 via 198.51.100.1 dev ens5
       | iptables -N ORBIT-JOIN 2>/dev/null || true
       | iptables -C ORBIT-JOIN -s 192.0.2.10/32 -i ens4 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 9551 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 192.0.2.10/32 -i ens4 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 9551 -j ACCEPT
       | iptables -C ORBIT-JOIN -s 10.250.0.0/16 -i ens5 -p udp -m udp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 10.250.0.0/16 -i ens5 -p udp -m udp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT
       | iptables -C ORBIT-JOIN -s 10.250.0.0/16 -i ens5 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 10.250.0.0/16 -i ens5 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT
       | iptables -C ORBIT-JOIN -s 198.51.100.0/24 -i ens5 -p udp -m udp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 198.51.100.0/24 -i ens5 -p udp -m udp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT
       | iptables -C ORBIT-JOIN -s 198.51.100.0/24 -i ens5 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -A ORBIT-JOIN -s 198.51.100.0/24 -i ens5 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 32768:60999 -j ACCEPT
       | iptables -C INPUT -m comment --comment orbit-join -j ORBIT-JOIN 2>/dev/null || iptables -I INPUT 1 -m comment --comment orbit-join -j ORBIT-JOIN
  7. install /etc/systemd/system/orbit-responder.service (not enabled or started):
       | [Unit]
       | Description=orbit N6 responder (orbit join)
       | Wants=network-online.target
       | After=network-online.target nftables.service iptables.service ip6tables.service netfilter-persistent.service
       | 
       | [Service]
       | User=orbit
       | Group=orbit
       | ExecStartPre=+/usr/local/lib/orbit/join-net.sh
       | ExecStart=/usr/local/lib/orbit/orbit responder --bind 192.0.2.20:9551
       | Restart=on-failure
       | NoNewPrivileges=yes
       | ProtectSystem=strict
       | ProtectHome=yes
       | PrivateTmp=yes
       | CapabilityBoundingSet=
       | RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX
       | 
       | [Install]
       | WantedBy=multi-user.target

orbit join: applied 7 changes.
